basis.derivation: Constant K < 0: j_head(s) = sinh(sqrt(-K) s)/sqrt(-K), strictly increasing, so the orders coincide; constant K > 0: j_head(s) = sin(sqrt K s)/sqrt K is not monotone (sin s on the unit sphere); variable K: routes of different lengths follow different Jacobi equations, so |j_head(L)| need not order like L (T032 torus witnesses) (ciw.lab.jacobi.constant_curvature)
